manifest.description: Diagnose Rust feature flags, cfg attributes, optional dependencies, and Cargo targets that encode accidental architecture boundaries.
when_to_use: feature gates are scattered across unrelated modules
optional provider or platform support leaks into core logic
a correction plan needs a validation matrix and G15 labeling
anti_patterns: do not use for cfg site counts alone
do not imply a mutating cfg atom exists; cfg restructuring is G15 or PD-manual
do not use on non-Rust targets
